name: What factors influence the valuation of an oceanfront condo?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the valuation of an oceanfront condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The valuation of an oceanfront condo is influenced by several key factors. These include direct ocean views, proximity to the beach, property condition, building amenities like pools or gyms, and the specific floor level of the unit. The desirability of the micro-location, such as being in Aventura, Bal Harbour, or South Beach, also plays a significant role due to varying market demands and prestige.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key factors include ocean views, proximity to the beach, property condition, building amenities, floor level, and micro-location desirability.
